title: Dungeon Friends Forever Manga Ends With 8th Volume
content: Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga physically and digitally, and describes the story: A charming fantasy rom-com about a human adventurer and his childhood friend, the dragon girl boss of a dungeon! Van the warrior and Ryuka the dragon have been friends since childhood.
author: ANN

title: Battle Royale: Enforcers Artist Yukai Asada Launches New Manga
content: Hero's Inc. 's HERO'S Web announced on September 16 Battle Royale: Enforcers artist Yukai Asada will launch a new manga titled Zombie Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? (I'm a Zombie, Any Questions?) on the platform on September 29.
author: ANN

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Anime Reveals Epilogue Visual
content: Though I Am an Inept Villainess anime revealed an epilogue visual featuring the main characters Kou Reirin and Shu Keigetsu. A second cour has been confirmed to premiere in January 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Synduality Echo of Ada Game to End Online Service in 2027
content: Bandai Namco Europe announced on Monday that Bandai Namco Entertainment 's Synduality Echo of Ada game will end its online service after May 2027, and will transition to an offline version. With the end of the online service, updates and events will no longer be available after the content scheduled for October.
author: ANN

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Gets Anime
content: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.
author: Anime Corner

title: Machibari, Juan Albarrán Each Launch New Manga on Manga One App
content: Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app announced on Monday its new autumn serializations, which include new series by Machibari and Juan Albarrán . Writer Machibari and artist Seseri's Mibun ga Gyakuten Itashimashite ( Somehow, Our Roles Were Reversed ) manga will launch on October 17.
author: ANN

title: Lone Wolf and Cub Deluxe Edition Manga Wins Ringo Award
content: The first volume of the Deluxe Edition of the manga shipped on December 9. The original manga centers on Ogami Ittō, who is an executioner for the Shogun. After he is framed and his wife murdered, he and his infant son Daigorō wander the country as assassins for hire, while also working toward their own revenge.
author: ANN

title: Zero-sen Hayato Anime Scriptwriter Sō Kuramoto Dies at 91
content: The official website of screenwriter Sō Kuramoto 's foundation Kuramoto Sō Kaiwai announced on Monday that he died on September 18 due to multiple organ failure. He was 91. A private funeral service with only close relatives in attendance was held in accordance with the family's wishes.
author: ANN

title: Psyren TV Anime Reveals Ending Song by Who-ya Extended
content: The anime will debut on Tokyo MX and BS11 on October 5 at 11:00 p.m., before airing later that evening on Sun TV . Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China.
author: ANN

title: Manchuria Opium Squad Manga Resumes Serialization With New Artist Tsurushima
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for writer Tsukasa Monma and the late artist Shikako 's Manchuria Opium Squad manga announced on Monday that the manga will resume in this year's 45th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine , which will ship on October 5.
author: ANN
